annotations.title: Buy an ad for a listing

description:
Buy an ad for one of this shop's live listings for `hours` (1 hour up to 90 days; a week when left out), paid in USDC over x402, priced pro rata from the weekly price. The first call returns the payment request (an error result holding the x402 PaymentRequired: price, network, recipient); sign it with an x402 client and call again with the same `listingId` and `hours` and the payment in `_meta["x402/payment"]`. Check the listing and the price with get_ad_offer first. A second ad for the same listing starts when the first ends.

Returns `ad` (`id`, `listing_id`, `status`, `hours`, `starts_at`, `ends_at`, `tx_hash`, `network`, `amount_atomic`) and `message`; the paid result also carries `_meta["x402/payment-response"]`.

hours.description: How long the ad should run, in hours: 24 for a day, 168 for a week, 720 for thirty days, or 1 to try it out. Leave it out for a week. It is priced pro rata from the weekly price; get_ad_offer prices any length before you buy

listingId.description: The id of one of this shop's live listings, from list_listings

name: promote_listing

ad.description: The ad bought: its id, its status and when it runs

amount_atomic.description: The price paid, in the token's smallest unit (USDC has 6 decimals: 3760000 is 3.76 USDC)

ends_at.description: When it stops being shown (ISO 8601). Null until paid

hours.description: How many hours it runs, as bought

id.description: The ad's id, as list_ads shows it

network.description: The payment network, as a CAIP-2 id (eip155:8453 is Base)

starts_at.description: When it starts being shown (ISO 8601); a second ad for the same listing starts when the first ends. Null until paid

status.description: "active" (paid: shown between starts_at and ends_at), "pending" or "unknown" (payment sent, confirmation not yet found: it starts once found; call promote_listing again with the same payment to check)

tx_hash.description: The payment's transaction on the network; null until it is known

message.description: What to do next while the payment is still being confirmed, to pass on to the person; null once the ad is paid
